text: {"lessons":["My account is down about 2.3% from Period 1 despite a brief rebound, so I should not assume small gains mean the risk has passed.","Monthly moves have gone both ways, including declines over 2%; I should stay calm and avoid impulsive trades in response to a single period.","Since I have not traded, I should review whether my holdings still fit my need for retirement stability, and make any changes cautiously rather than trading frequently."]}
